Label: Machine downtime analysis
Description: Downtime of one fleet machine over the dashboard time range, decomposed by stop cause: availability, MTBF and MTTR, Pareto chart and table (archived state and cause datapoints).

Settings.StateMappingHint: Bind the atelier configuration datapoint (MachineFleet3D_<atelier>.json) or paste a mapping JSON. Empty = fleet standard (0 = stop, 1 = production, 2 = fault, 3 = maintenance).
Settings.MachineIdHint: Id of the machine inside the atelier configuration: its own state mapping is used.
Settings.StateMappingIdHint: Id of the mapping to use inside the atelier configuration when no machine id is given. Empty = first mapping.
Settings.StopCausesHint: Bind MachineFleet3D_StopCauses.json. The catalog gives each code its label AND its planned / unplanned classification; without it every stop counts as unplanned.
